text: This solution, Building Safety and Resilience in the Pacific Phase II – Papua New Guinea Country Program (BSRP II – PNG) addresses natural catastrophe in Papua New Guinea between National Disaster Centre, National Weather Service, Port Moresby Geophysical Observatory, Department of Community Development and Religion, Department of Education, Department of National Planning and Monitoring, The Pacific Community (SPC), and European Union. The program was implemented in 2024 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
